description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for a custom logging framework that interfaces with Android's native logging facilities. It provides static methods for various log levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a linked list of LogNode objects for flexible log processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class to abstract logging operations, allowing chaining of LogNodes and mapping calls to Android's native logging system.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends log data to the current LogNode; can include a Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with optional Throwable.
